Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for assay CHEMBL5732041. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assay CHEMBL5732041, non-null standard_value, non-null standard_relation, and standard_relation equals '='. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
